answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 31428 Country: India Title: My question is that some people from madrasa take amount to perfom qurbani from us. Question: My question is that some people from madrasa take amount to perfom qurbani from us the qurbani is performed in the morning before the namaz is performed by us does the qurbani is accepted in eyes of islam Answer ID: 31428 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 652/465/L=1432) If they perform Qurbani after salah or that madrasa is located in a village where the salah of Eidain is not wajib, your Qurbani will be valid, though you have not performed your salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
